SCENE 1. A rain-soaked alley in Shanghai, 1937.
SHEN walks quickly under a broken umbrella. MEI waits in a doorway.
SHEN: The office was searched again. We cannot stay here.
MEI: Then we finish the story tonight, or not at all.
SHEN: The rain will cover the sound of the presses.

SCENE 2. A dry newspaper office, later that night.
MEI lays the pages on the desk. SHEN checks the door.
MEI: If we print this, they will close the paper.
SHEN: Then we print it before they can.
